Powerbase: Los Angeles says "If you use that discard phase action to
discard a card that requires an anarch or a card that makes a vampire an
anarch, you may untap a ready anarch."

Does Seattle Committee count as a card that makes a vampire an anarch?

I would say yes, but unlike Galaric's Legacy and Go Anarch, the actual
playing of the card doesn't make any vampires into anarchs.

thanks!

Josh
